Reduced from a live Radeon AI PRO R9700 (RDNA4) host observed during
implementation: 32 GiB dedicated VRAM beside a larger system-RAM GTT
pool, KFD FB_PRIVATE heap, and a v1.3 blob whose throttle fields keep
the memset 0xFF sentinel. Guards the discrete-vs-APU pool rule and the
throttle sentinel rule. Identifiers sanitized.
